conventions.DUP-PAY: V-031 only: same vendor, invoice and amount within DUP.WINDOW_DAYS. V-045's 3 x 48,000 have the same vendor and amount within the window but different invoice numbers (not a duplicate)
conventions.FOR-ROUND: V-120: 40 of 40 payments round. V-045 has 3 round payments of about 50 (6 %)
conventions.FOR-BENFORD: V-099 is the only vendor with >= FOR.BENFORD.MIN_N (1,000) payments; the whole file is within the acceptable MAD (< 0.012)
conventions.suggested_risks: library risks the data supports (roles present) and that have a planted case, minus the two the auditor asked for: A-R3, A-R4, G-R2, G-R4. G-R3 would need time of day (date only), G-R1 has no planted case
